svg.title: Same model, different outcomes
svg.desc: A chalkboard diagram inside the outline of the Orange Tomato mascot's head. One model (DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731) and one input note (113 DeepSWE tasks, hand-written verifiers) feed three shown harnesses: CodeAF senior-dev with 62 solved at $0.40 per solve, mini-swe-agent with 56 at $0.77, and muse-code with 3 at $4.51. A fourth card covers the other seven harnesses: codex 51, pi 42, omp/kilo/opencode 31/30/30, claude-code 16, deepseek-harness 16. Notes: cost per solve is model API spend; vendor-run comparison; middle-cluster order inferred.

g.text: cost per solve = model API spend
